facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: uncontrolled movement of TK-7103 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-7103 and PSV-7103 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on TK-7103 and PSV-7103 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TK-7103 and PSV-7103 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. TK-7103 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 9 April 2020 an incident occurred on TK-7103 and PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
